invariants.rationale: The method always returns 'this', which cannot be null in instance methods.
The method returns 'this' after setting the field.
The returned object's fill field will equal the method parameter 'fill' just set on 'this'.
Typically, fill factors like this for layout should not be negative (this may be an assumption based on the Javadoc context).
Since 'result.fill == fill', if the method expects non-negative fills, this holds as well.
